Block.Name: ORDERS
Block.OrderByClause: ORDER_NO DESC NULLS LAST, STATUS ASC

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText: IF :ORDERS.STATUS IS NULL THEN MESSAGE('Choose a status'); MESSAGE('Choose a status'); END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: REFRESH_ACCESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText: PROCEDURE REFRESH_ACCESS IS BEGIN SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ORDERS.ACTION_BUTTON', ENABLED, PROPERTY_TRUE); SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE); IF :ORDERS.STATUS = 'Y' THEN SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ORDERS.ACTION_BUTTON', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE); SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE); END IF; END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FAILURE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText: PROCEDURE CHECK_FAILURE IS BEGIN IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS THEN RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; END IF; END;
